mapper.select: SELECT /* getCurrentUserMenu */ MENUMATCH.MENU_NUMB , MENUMATCH.SUBX_NUMB , MENUMATCH.MENU_NAME , MENUMATCH.MENU_URLX , MENUMATCH.SORT_ORDR FROM ( SELECT MENU.MENU_NUMB , MENU.SUBX_NUMB , MENU.MENU_NAME , MENU.MENU_URLX , MENU.SORT_ORDR FROM TM_URMENU MENU WHERE MENU.MENU_URLX = #{menuUrlx} OR ( SUBSTR(MENU.MENU_URLX, -1) = '/' AND #{menuUrlx} LIKE MENU.MENU_URLX || '%' ) ORDER BY LENGTH(MENU.MENU_URLX) DESC ) MENUMATCH WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT /* getVisibleUserMenuList */ MENU_NUMB , SUBX_NUMB , MENU_NAME , MENU_URLX , SORT_ORDR FROM TM_URMENU WHERE SHOW_YSNO = #{commYes} AND USEE_YSNO = #{commYes} ORDER BY NVL(SORT_ORDR, 9999) , MENU_NUMB , SUBX_NUMB
